Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 15-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the PGIMER Lab Technician recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the PGIMER Lab Technician recruitment is 15th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Lab Technician post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc in Medical Lab Technology or a B.Sc with a Diploma in MLT from a recognized University, Institute, or Board to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Lab Technician position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Lab Technician post is 30 years. Age relaxation will be provided to eligible candidates as per the rules of the Government of India.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Lab Technician role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Lab Technician position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 28,000 plus HRA. This is a contractual appointment.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Lab Technician post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Lab Technician post announced in this recruitment drive by PGIMER Chandigarh.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application for the PGIMER Lab Technician recruitment must be submitted in an offline mode. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Lab Technician position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Lab Technician role will involve a Written Test followed by an Interview. Candidates need to perform well in both stages.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for the PGIMER Lab Technician recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of PGIMER Chandigarh, which is www.pgimer.edu.in. Always refer to the official website for the most accurate information.

faq.question: Q10. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The job for the Lab Technician post is on a contractual basis. This means the appointment will be for a fixed tenure as per the terms and conditions of the institute.
